questions.stem_text:
Which of the following was not cited as evidence for life in the martian meteorite ALH
84001?

options.B: Magnetite grains similar to those formed by bacteria on Earth
options.C: Carbonate minerals indicating a thicker warmer Martian atmosphere
options.D: Amino acids with a preferred orientation or "chirality"

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Amino acids with a preferred orientation or "chirality"

ice-rich soil?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Phoenix Mars Lander

questions.stem_text: You observe the visible spectrum of a star viewed through a cloud of cool hydrogen gas.

options.A: You see only the star's blackbody spectrum.
options.B: You see the star's blackbody spectrum with absorption lines due to hydrogen.
options.C: You see only emission lines characteristic of hydrogen.
options.D: You see only emission lines characteristic of the star's composition.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - You see the star's blackbody spectrum with absorption lines due to hydrogen.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following countries has sent landers to Venus?
By locating the north celestial pole (NCP) in the sky how can you determine your latitude?

options.A: The azimuth of the NCP is the angular distance from the North Pole.
options.B: The azimuth of the NCP is the same as your latitude.
options.C: The altitude of the NCP is the same as your latitude.
options.D: The altitude of the NCP is your angular distance from the North Pole.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The altitude of the NCP is the same as your latitude.
